title: STEMEd+ Awards listing
description: One national or international award for STEM+ teaching, STEM+ education research, or education-adjacent work such as science communication. One file per award (or per closely related set of awards from one sponsor) in awards/.

name.description: Award name as the sponsor gives it.

url.description: The sponsor's own page for the award.

status.description: open: taking nominations now. upcoming: next deadline announced. between-cycles: annual, next dates not yet posted. periodic: given every two or more years. paused: sponsor has paused it.

deadline_note.description: How the cycle usually runs, in a sentence.

prize.description: Cash prize, medal, lecture, travel, and so on.

eligibility.description: Who can be nominated, and who can nominate, in a sentence or two.

open_to.description: International: nominees from any country. National: nominees from the country or countries in `country`. Leave out if the sponsor does not say.

country.description: For national awards, e.g. 'United States' or 'United Kingdom and Ireland'.

nomination.description: self: you apply yourself. self-or-others: self-nominations welcome. others: someone else must nominate you. institution: your school, university, or another organization nominates. see-sponsor: the sponsor's page does not say; check before nominating.

stages.description: Career stages the award is limited to; leave out if any stage can be nominated.

levels.description: Where the nominee's teaching or work takes place; leave out if any level.

summary.description: What it recognizes, in your own words.

disciplines.description: Leave empty for awards open to all STEM+ fields. Labels from the STEMEd+ discipline list (stemed_awards/stemedplus_disciplines.json, kept in stemedplus-theme); the build checks them against that list.

checked.description: When someone last checked this against the sponsor's page.
